## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the bodhisattva-prince *Tài zǐ shuā hù* 太子刷護 (a Sanskrit-name reconstruction unclear). With *[Tài zǐ hé xiū jīng 太子和休經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0036)* (T0344) it forms a parallel-translation pair.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The Taishō text (T0343) is established on the standard apparatus.
